Extract multiple Open Graph tags including type, url, and site_name

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<html><head><meta property=\"og:title\" content=\"Article Title\"><meta property=\"og:type\" content=\"article\"><meta property=\"og:url\" content=\"https://example.com/article\"><meta property=\"og:site_name\" content=\"Example Site\"><meta property=\"og:description\" content=\"An interesting article.\"><meta property=\"og:image\" content=\"https://example.com/article.jpg\"></head><body><article><p>Article content here.</p></article></body></html>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
